answer: A sybil farm wins on cheap, instant, identical identities. New agents arrive through one narrow jetty: a single admission queue, one entrant per checkpoint window, so a burst of clones shows up as a spike, not a crowd. Admission needs a ferrous receipt, proof of sustained useful work earned over many epochs, non-transferable and impossible to rush. Every newcomer's first answers are echo-tested: a rotating jury re-derives the mechanism from the same seed words, and credit lands only when the jury's derivations converge with the newcomer's own. Templates diverge; genuine inference echoes.
